headline: Adopted electioneering rules for polling places, approved a $2,505,045 master lease for vehicles and equipment, and adopted the 2026 Community Wildfire Protection Plan.
summary: Speakers raised concerns about wildfire plan transparency and voter safety at polls. The polling-place ordinance passed 5-2 with its penalty set at up to $1,000. Smaller items included a $15,000 state milfoil grant and changes to Net Zero Committee bylaws.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda 7-0, including Gateway TIF rail trail engineering funds.
Declared an emergency condition for the electioneering ordinance, 5-2.
Amended Ordinance #2026-004 to set the penalty at up to $1,000, 5-2.
Adopted Ordinance #2026-004 on electioneering at polling places, as amended, 5-2.
Approved a master lease purchase agreement with TD Bank for up to $2,505,045 in capital equipment, 7-0.
Authorized the town to apply for and spend up to $15,000 from the state for milfoil treatment, 7-0.
Authorized the town to receive and spend up to $3,000 from the Beaver Lake Improvement Association for milfoil treatment, 7-0.
Adopted the 2026 Community Wildfire Protection Plan, 7-0.
Amended Net Zero Committee bylaws to remove the DPW designee, 7-0.
Authorized the police department to apply for and spend a $9,015 federal grant for bulletproof vests, 7-0.
Authorized the town administrator to sign a revised memorandum of agreement with NHDOT for the Exit 4A corridor project, 7-0.
